messages:
maya: FYI pushed a small fix for Cascade Health private gateway (MSK-2983). It addresses the asymmetric route that caused failed connections on their staging VPC. PR: https://git.redwood/inference/cascade-health/compare/PR-2983 :wave:

sam: taking a look now. is this safe to merge during the overnight maintenance window? we have a scheduled deploy at 03:00 UTC.

maya: yes, should be safe. change is a single route priority swap + a guard for missing annotations. no schema changes. I tested with their staging route table and the health-check now passes.

liam: ran the terraform plan locally — looks fine but left one nit about variable naming. also, can we add a short changelog line in the module for audit?

maya: good call. updated commit to include changelog. PTAL.

ci-bot: CI passed — unit tests 148/148, integration matrix aws: us-east-1 OK. build #5421 ✅

sam: quick note: can we squash the fixup commits before merging? keeps the commit history tidy for the customer bundle.

maya: will squash.

ellen: does this require a migration on Cascade side or any firewall rule updates? I want to make sure support has the steps ready.

maya: no firewall changes. just the route priority adjustment — included the exact commands in the PR description. copying them here for support:```bash
# on customer VPC admin
terraform apply -target=module.private_gateway.aws_route.priority_swap
# verify
aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=tag:Name,Values=cascade-staging
```

liam: approved with a comment on var name; non-blocking. :thumbsup:

sam: second approval from me after squash.

release-bot: merge check: requires 2 approvals and green CI — satisfied. scheduled merge window: 2026-03-18 03:00 UTC.

maya: merging now and will monitor staging post-deploy. thanks all! :rocket:
